status_basis: The local Ollama path completed the primary SkillGen training workflow after an escalated rerun was required for local HTTP access.
The post-fix verification sampler selected two baseline failures and two success guards, exercising the intended repair path.
Construction verification passed with baseline_acc=0.5, skill_acc=0.75, repair_count=2, regression_count=1, and net_gain=1.
Held-out evaluation completed on 16 test instances but did not improve over baseline: baseline_acc=1.0, skill_acc=0.9375, net_gain=-1.
primary_question_answer: The local infrastructure fixes and stratified sampler fix work end to end and produce durable evidence. The generated skill itself is not validated as improving held-out MCP-Bench performance in this run.
limitations: This is a solution-validation run against a reconstructed local Ollama/hash-embedding path, not reproduction of the original paper's reported numerical claims.
The held-out sample had no baseline failures, so repair ability was not tested out of sample.
The active skill reduced held-out binary accuracy by one instance and reduced mean judge score on the sampled test set.
The first training attempt failed under sandboxed local HTTP restrictions; the successful run required escalation for local Ollama access.
